scope: Independent read-only source/complete AST review; no code mutation, imports of Torch/HF, tests, remote, model or GPU execution
checks: Complete capture() AST unchanged from verified storage owner
All boundary_row_storage branches, including last_slots and per-boundary capture selection, retain exact verified AST

composition_findings.finding: For each zipped source/original row and its own n, compact selection uses source.boundary_rows[n][row]; mixed compact/noncompact sources preserve the original row for sources with boundary_rows=None. The all-None fast branch uses the unchanged original torch.cat selections.

last_slots is the final padded capture occurrence per canonical UID, matching existing sources[uid] last-write semantics. Only the final slot for each UID stores its consumed boundaries; sources assignment still runs in original padded order.
Individual mode retains original synchronized common-zero branch and collective call count. It changes only per-row captured cuts; no-cache common-zero consumer remains unchanged.

limits: Source composition review only. Does not replace original CPU check_contracts, actual compact-plus-row B8 execution, exact32768 capacity or official kernel numerical assertions.
